subject: Renewal + SOW update: Lighthouse PR & Event support (Q4 pilot -> annual)
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Schmidt <nora@lighthouse-pr.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Renewal + SOW update: Lighthouse PR & Event support (Q4 pilot -> annual)

Hi Nora —

Hope you had a good week. We're coming up on the end of our Q4 pilot with Lighthouse (PR + on-site event ops support for the Redwood Summit regional run). Marketing wants to move to an annual retainer but we need a few updates before committing:

- Consolidated SOW that separates PR retainer vs event day labor (we need clear billing bands).
- A 30-day pilot extension option (fixed fee) in case the Summit results require extra on-site coverage.
- Pricing capped for the first 6 months with an optional CPI tie after month 6.
- A short list of named contractors you plan to staff for event day ops.

Can you send an updated proposal + SOW and a sample PO/invoice cadence? Marcus and Laura are looped for budget and vendor ops.

We referenced the draft you sent in September (attached below) — ideally we can get a version to review by EOD Tuesday so we can present to Finance next Wednesday.

Thanks,
Aisha

--
Aisha Rahman
Head of Growth Programs | Redwood Inference
aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0186

Attachments: Lighthouse_proposal_v1.pdf (proposal, pricing table)
From: Nora Schmidt <nora@lighthouse-pr.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: contracts@lighthouse-pr.com
Date: 2026-10-12T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + SOW update: Lighthouse PR & Event support (Q4 pilot -> annual)

Hi Aisha —

Thanks for the clear ask. Attached is an updated proposal that breaks out PR retainers and event ops labor and includes a 30-day pilot extension option (line item B). We kept the first-6-month cap as requested and added a CPI clause for months 7–12 (capped at 3%).

Highlights:
- PR retainer: $18k/mo (up to 12 media pitches, 4 thought leadership placements)
- Event ops block: $12k/day for on-site lead + 4 technicians (rates and overtime spelled out)
- Pilot extension: $9k flat fee for 30 days of continued PR + on-call event support
- Named contractors for event ops: Ben Hall (Eventcraft) as lead, plus two technicians (TBA)

I've attached Lighthouse_SOW_revised.docx (redline-friendly). If this looks good to you, we can send a DocuSign link for the SOW and a sample PO template.

Best,
Nora

--
Nora Schmidt
Director, Client Partnerships
Lighthouse PR & Events
nora@lighthouse-pr.com
Attachments: Lighthouse_SOW_revised.docx
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + SOW update: Lighthouse PR & Event support (Q4 pilot -> annual)

Aisha / Marcus —

I reviewed the proposal Nora sent. Quick notes before we push this to Finance:

- Total run-rate (headcount + event days for 2 regional Summits) comes in ~ $360k annualized at proposed rates. That's above current budget. Can we ask for a 10% concession if we commit to a 12-month term?
- Need explicit SLAs for response times on press inquiries (PR), and an escalation path for reputational issues.
- Contract term and termination: prefer 60-day exit with pro-rata settlement for open event bookings.

Marcus — can you confirm whether we have runway for a one-time ramp fee for the first Summit (~$25k)? If not, let's ask for that to be absorbed into the pilot extension fee.

I cc'd Grace for standard legal redlines.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Sr. Marketing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-13T09:25:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + SOW update: Lighthouse PR & Event support (Q4 pilot -> annual)

Laura / Aisha —

Quick update from finance run: we can fund a $25k ramp fee one-time if leadership signs off, but only if the annual commitment includes the 10% concession Laura mentioned OR if we split the ramp fee across Q4/Q1 operational budgets. Prefer the concession route.

I recommend we ask Nora for: (1) a 10% discount for a 12-month commitment, (2) clarified SLAs, and (3) the pilot extension folded into the ramp fee at no additional cost. If Lighthouse won't budge on pricing, we'll propose a phased scope (remove X number of earned media pitches/month).

Marcus

--
Marcus Lin
Head of Finance Operations | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com
From: Nora Schmidt <nora@lighthouse-pr.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: contracts@lighthouse-pr.com
Date: 2026-10-15T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + SOW update: Lighthouse PR & Event support (Q4 pilot -> annual)

Hi all —

Thanks for the thoughtful notes. We can accept a 10% concession for a 12-month commitment and will fold the $25k ramp into the pilot extension fee (we'll guarantee on-site staffing). Attached is a redline-ready SOW and a DocuSign envelope — link below.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/sign/ABC-RENEWAL-2026

We added SLA language for PR inquiries (24-hour initial response, 72-hour campaign resolution) and an escalation ladder to the agency director. We also added a 60-day termination with pro-rata settlement for booked events.

Please have your legal review and send any redlines back by Friday.

Warmly,
Nora

Attachments: Lighthouse_SOW_revised.docx
From: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Nora Schmidt <nora@lighthouse-pr.com>, contracts@lighthouse-pr.com
Cc: Aisha Rahman <aisha_rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-16T10:50:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Renewal + SOW update: Lighthouse PR & Event support (Q4 pilot -> annual)

Nora / Lighthouse contracts team —

Thanks for the updated SOW. I've attached a PDF with our standard redlines (SOW_RI_redlined.pdf). High-level items:

- Data handling clause: require confirmation that media lists and contact data are deleted after 12 months unless expressly retained with written consent.
- Indemnity: narrow to direct damages only; remove broad consequential language.
- Insurance: please confirm event ops carry GL and tech liability and provide certificates prior to first on-site day.

We're OK with the 10% concession and folding the ramp fee into the pilot extension. Once redlines are accepted, please re-upload the clean SOW to DocuSign and we'll route for signature.

Regards,
Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Head of Legal | Redwood Inference
grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: SOW_RI_redlined.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwoodinference.com>

Cc: contracts@lighthouse-pr.com, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Final: PO and next steps for Lighthouse annual retainer

Nora / Lighthouse team —

We're good to move forward. Finance raised a PO (PO_2026-445.pdf attached) reflecting the agreed 10% concession and the ramp fee rolled into the pilot extension. Please countersign the attached DocuSign envelope and confirm named on-site lead (Ben Hall) for the Summit dates 2027-03-12 / 2027-03-13.

Next steps:
- Lighthouse: countersign SOW via DocuSign (link was shared 10/15).
- Redwood: once countersigned, we'll wire 50% of the ramp fee per the PO terms and set up monthly invoices.

Thanks everyone — excited to keep building here.

Jordan
